name: Lamu mtepe model
description: A locally built rigged model of a Lamu mtepe, classified in the museum catalogue as a sewn boat.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A locally built mtepe model from Lamu is catalogued to 1901–1930.

evidence.supports: The museum dates a locally made, rigged wooden mtepe model from Lamu to 1901–1930 and lists its maker as unknown; it is a scale model, not a surviving working boat.

events.caveats: The object is a model; its maker is unknown and the dating range does not prove a working vessel was built in any particular year.

earliest_record.rationale: The museum dates this model to 1901–1930; this is not a date of origin for mtepe vessels.

research.note: Museum catalogue inspected; the working-vessel description and its date are deferred pending direct inspection of Hornell. Independent review pending.

unresolved.note: The museum model does not establish an origin date, named shipwright, construction details of a working vessel, or transmission to any represented Indian Ocean vessel. Hornell’s original was not inspected during this repair.
